name: uniformdev
description: Build with Uniform: framework integrations, experience modeling, Mesh, assets, and the Uniform MCP server.

UNIFORM_PROJECT_ID.title: Uniform project ID
UNIFORM_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional — needed only for the Uniform MCP server, not for the skills. Found in your Uniform project settings, or via `Copy as mcp json` in the dashboard. You can add it later under Plugins → Configure.

UNIFORM_API_KEY.title: Uniform API key
UNIFORM_API_KEY.description: Optional — needed only for the Uniform MCP server, not for the skills. A Service Account key or Personal Access Token with the Developer role on the project. You can add it later under Plugins → Configure.

UNIFORM_AI_HOST.title: Uniform AI host
UNIFORM_AI_HOST.description: Region-specific MCP endpoint, including the `https://` scheme. Leave the default unless your team is in another region.
